## Pearly Stitch

[![Pearly Stitch talking to Discord — *Discordant Harmony* show still](https://derpicdn.net/img/view/2024/2/10/3298161__safe_screencap_discord_pearly%2Bstitch_draconequus_discordant%2Bharmony_g4_my%2Blittle%2Bpony-colon-%2Bfriendship%2Bis%2Bmagic_crossed%2Barms.png)](https://derpibooru.org/images/3298161)

Pearly Stitch is the small, outspoken elderly Earth-pony mare with a nearly white, pale-blue coat, curly pale-pink mane, blue eyes, and a purple ball-of-yarn cutie mark. You might recognize her as the old lady who gets caught in Discord's conversation with himself. The show still above is from *Friendship Is Magic*; production credit: Hasbro/DHX Media.

**Name and voice.** “Pearly Stitch” is an *official merchandise name*, printed on Enterplay's *Premiere* collectible card #73 C, subtitled “Crotchety Crocheter”; that subtitle is a card epithet, not a separate identity. On television she is not addressed by name: credits use “Elderly Pony” (*Made in Manehattan*) and “Older Pony” (*Discordant Harmony*). English voices are attributed to Andrea Libman (S5E16) and Tabitha St. Germain (S7E12). See the [Enterplay card checklist](https://www.mylittlewiki.org/wiki/Enterplay_Collectible_Card_Game_%28CCG%29_Cards) and [character/credit reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Pearly_Stitch).

**Where else to spot her.** She appears as a young mare in the flashbacks of *The Perfect Pear* (S7E13), later among the retirees at Silver Shoals in *The Point of No Return* (S9E5), and in IDW's *Friends Forever* #27 and *Ponyville Mysteries* #3. *Equestria Girls* has a separate human counterpart, memorably knitting in *Super Squad Goals*; she is a counterpart, not an alter ego.

[![Pearly Stitch's human counterpart knitting beside Applejack — *Super Squad Goals*](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/18/1375924/full.png)](https://twibooru.org/1375924)

*Second image: official Equestria Girls animation still, credited to Hasbro/DHX Media.*

## Important moments

- **Balcony rescue — *The Mysterious Mare Do Well* (S2E8):** Rainbow Dash catches Pearly and other elderly ponies when their balcony collapses. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lZMf0sB5Hnk) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **Neighborhood spirit returns — *Made in Manehattan* (S5E16):** Pearly thanks the organizers of the revived community play and says the neighborhood has not felt so friendly since Charity moved away. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CPOaGUDGzF0) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **Accidental conversation with Discord — *Discordant Harmony* (S7E12):** She politely asks whether he was talking to her while he argues with versions of himself, providing the scene's punch line. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AClTrMuDZFc) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **An opinionated reader — *Fame and Misfortune* (S7E14):** Joining the criticism of Twilight's published friendship journal, she declares that Twilight was better before she got wings. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9VD69mYisoU) (scene timestamp unavailable).
